messages:
maria: Heads up — legal asked for a formal 'cordon' mode doc. Current behavior is messy: proxies sometimes redirect writes and our KV ownership becomes ambiguous. We need a safe operator-friendly flow for cordoning a region.

aj: What's in-scope? legal takedowns, network partitions, datacenter isolation?

maria: Both. Requirements: 1) block new resident writes where required, 2) keep in-flight sessions working where safe, 3) hand off hot KV prefixes without split-brain, 4) measurable telemetry for handoff success.

sam: Our sticky affinity today is proxy cookie + control-plane lease. On cordon we expire leases; proxies then start returning errors. Not graceful for live sessions.

ellie: Proposed dataplane state machine: NORMAL -> CORDON_GRACE -> HANDOFF -> READ_ONLY -> CORDONED. Control-plane emits cordon signal with a handoff window (X-Cordon-Until). Proxies and workers react deterministically.

chen: Quick proxy pseudo-behavior: 
```
if tenant.requires_residency && node.region == tenant.region && node.cordoned:
  if now < node.handoff_until:
    allow reads. for writes -> forward to fallback with header X-Escrow-Write: <escrow-id>
  else:
    reject 409 "region cordoned"
else:
  route normally
```

sam: The KV cache handoff is the tricky bit. Option A: lease handshake where owner exports a hot-prefix snapshot to fallback and marks prefixes AS_ESCROWED until replay completes. Option B: mark prefixes read-only and rely on fallback to rebuild cache from cold storage + live traffic. A is faster but more complex.

aj: We should leverage an idempotent escrow write path. Fallbacks accept escrowed writes and tag them with escrow ids. When original owner finishes replay it issues a replay-complete event that triggers conflict resolution. That requires strict ordering guarantees for strong-residency tenants.

ellie: Telemetry events to emit: cordon_initiated, cordon_grace_end, lease_handshake_start, prefix_escrowed, escrow_write_accepted, replay_complete, cordon_cleared. Ops can build an SLO on % of prefixes successfully handed off within the grace window.

maria: Operational checklist proposal (owners):
- proxy routing interface change to honor cordon headers (aj) — 5d
- control-plane cordon API + UI + audit log (ellie) — 4d
- KV lease handshake prototype + prefix-escrow flag (sam) — 10d
- escrow write header semantics + idempotency keys (chen) — 3d
I'll own coordination and runbook updates.

ops-bot: incident-bot: added runbook note "region cordon" to /runbooks/region-cordon and set page policy to p1 for legal cordon events.

chen: I'll spike header semantics and tests this week; will include a curlable control-plane stub for local testing.

sam: I'll run a 3-day experiment to test lease handshake for small tenant sets and record sequence diagrams + failure modes.

aj: Consider also a fallback-policy field per-tenant: force-local-fallback, allow-global-fallback, or block. That lets us respect legal constraints per tenant during cordon.

ellie: Note: KMS/HSM constraints — some tenants may require keys bound to a region; escrow replay must not expose plaintext outside permitted region. Legal needs to sign off on escrow_read/write scope.

maria: Good call. Add a gating task: compliance signoff for escrow metadata and KMS scope (ellie).

sam: One more thing: during handoff we should temporarily slow request ingress (circuit-breaker) to avoid thundering herd on fallback warming. Add a per-tenant ramp-down policy.

aj: +1. Also we'll add a canary rollout for the control-plane cordon signal to 1% of tenants first.

ellie: I'll add the telemetry events and dashboards in the cordon UI mock so operators can see progress at-a-glance.

maria: Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00. Bring sequence diagrams, KMS/legal constraints, and a short failure-mode doc. :calendar:
